work_identified: Alchimistisch Sieben-Gestirn (1675 Hamburg first ed.; 1756 Frankfurt Fleischer ed.) — German anthology of seven Latin alchemical treatises: Hermes Trismegistus 'Tractatus Aureus', pseudo-Lull 'Apertorium', pseudo-Lull 'Elucidarium', pseudo-Aristotle to Alexander, John Dastin (Daustenii) 'Rosarium', Albertus Magnus compendium, John Pontanus 'Epistola'. Compiled and translated from Latin into German by anonymous editor; distinct from the individual Latin source texts.
